_contract: Frozen in the Phase 0 commit, before any ACG resolver existed. Do not edit to make an implementation pass.
ablation_rule: After removing the listed records, the capability of 'action' must have no behavioral class, and every other expected class must be unchanged.
text_invariance: Rewriting every affordance label and observation title (random per occurrence, and a zh-CN rendering) must leave partitions, classes, claim statuses and learned predicates unchanged across all T1 and T3 logs; only display labels may differ.

random_subsets.rule: On random record subsets (manifest kept), every asserted class must cite its rule and evidence ids that exist in the log and satisfy the rule's minimum status.

label_provenance: Every display label in the export must occur verbatim in a record it cites.
